candidates.sentence: "Our fundraising success is a testament to the shared belief that it will take conservative outsiders like me - not career politicians, career bureaucrats or career candidates - to fix the major issues our nation faces including securing the southern border, protecting taxpayer dollars, keeping the promises made to our veterans, and fighting for our conservative values."
As our next Member of Congress, Sheri will work tirelessly to build the wall, stop the flow of illegal aliens and drugs into our country, and replace “catch-and-release” with “stop-and-deport.”
As our next Congresswoman, Sheri will fight for fiscal responsibility, accountability, and transparency of our hard-earned tax dollars.
